about: How the crew talk (design/ROADMAP.md, decision 3): real modern military words, joint service, because the ship carries naval crew, aircrew and marines. Not pirate talk, not Royal Navy folk speech. `use` is the words to reach for, with what each means; `avoid` is what not to say, each with the word to say instead. tools/check.mjs checks every spoken line (the career, the watch pipes, the announcements) against `avoid`, and every line Gemini writes for the crew (phase 8) is checked the same way. Ranks and job titles in people's names (Coxswain, Leading Hand) are the story bible's to settle, and are not checked here.
